verses.gurmukhi: ੬ : ਬੇਮੁਖ ਗਿੱਦੜ ਦਾਖ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਦੋਸ਼ ਦੂਏ ਨੂੰ
verses.translit_en: 6 : bemukh gi'dhaR dhaakh hai aapanaa dhosh dhooe noo(n)

en.bdb: The apostate puts blame on others   ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਦੜ ਦਾਖ ਨਾ ਅਪੜੈ ਆਖੈ ਥੂਹ ਕਉੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gidhaR dhaakh naa apaRai aakhai thooh kauRee|

en.bdb: The jackal cannot reach the grapes and says disdainfully that grapes are sour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਚਣੁ ਨਚਿ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਖੈ ਭੁਇ ਸਉੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: nachan nach naa jaaniee aakhai bhui sauRee|

en.bdb: The dancer knows no dance but says that the place is narrow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਭੈਰਉ ਸੋ ਗਉੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: bolai agai gaaveeaai bhairau so gauRee|

en.bdb: Before a deaf person singing in measure Bhairav or Gaul is the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸਾਂ ਨਾਲਿ ਟਟੀਹਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਦਉੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)saa(n) naal TaTeeharee kiau pahuchai dhauRee|

en.bdb: How a plover can fly equal to a swan.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਅਕੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਅਉੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: saavan van hareeaavale ak ja(n)mai aauRee|

en.bdb: The whole of the forest goes green in rainy season (sit-van) but akk, the wild plant of sandy region (calotropis procera) grows in the period of drought.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਦੇਖਈ ਜਿਉ ਛੁਟੜਿ ਛਉੜੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: bemukh sukh naa dhekhiee jiau chhuTaR chhauRee ||6||

en.bdb: The apostate cannot have happiness like an abandoned woman.
